title: Multiple Choice - Closest in Meaning
description: Choose the word or phrase CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.text: Lighting decorative floating candles along the canal is an ancient [custom] observed by generations of townspeople.
Steamed lotus seed pudding is a renowned regional [speciality] that visitors eagerly seek out at the spring fair.
The energetic street acrobats managed to [captivate] the huge festival audience with their daring balance stunts.
Joyful [festivities] filled the town square as families gathered to celebrate the arrival of the new lunar year.
Wearing hand-embroidered ethnic motifs on casual denim jackets represents an exciting modern fashion [trend].
